source: User-supplied Expanded CRD, retained as text.
general_rules: Energy attacks cost 2 stages unless otherwise stated; default damage is 4 life cards.
Physical attack damage uses the Attack Table unless otherwise stated.
Defense Shield activates on the first otherwise unstopped attack of its stated type.
Combat card becomes Event; Non-Combat without Drill becomes Setup. Timing references to Combat remain Combat.
Focused attacks retain Focused. Endurance is separate from playable card effects.
